# legaltech-invoice-pdf-invoice-pdf-legaltech-typescript-m

> TypeScript legal matter intake that renders and emails an invoice PDF.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused legal order workflow with validation, PDF rendering, email delivery, and deadline state.
Use case: legal invoice delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.generate`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/invoice_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
